source.surface: personal-information consent modal blocking the page, purposes listed with their toggles already on
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControl: Accept All at the top, Confirm at the bottom
decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid violet fill with a white label, on both controls
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Reject All, outlined with no fill, placed immediately left of Accept All and offered only at the top of the modal
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the modal body is white, but the two optional purpose toggles are already painted in the enabled violet before the user has decided anything
decisionColour.optionalGrantDefault: on — Analytics and Targeted Advertising both render in their granted state on arrival
decisionColour.verdict: Recorded as a COUNTER-INSTANCE. The accept hue does not sit only on the button: it is already painted on the purpose toggles, which are the controls that carry the actual grant. A surface that arrives with the decision colour on the undecided controls has answered the question before the reader reached it.
